title: HELIX: Purified and Unified - Rethinking Feature Interaction and Sequence Modeling for Large-Scale Recommendation
title_zh: HELIX：纯化与统一——重新思考大规模推荐中的特征交互与序列建模
abstract_en: Industrial recommendation ranking models typically scale along two modeling axes: feature interaction over heterogeneous user, item, context, and cross features, and sequence modeling over long, informative, and multi-type user behavior histories. We find that scaling either capability in isolation is insufficient, as each exhibits a limited scaling ceiling and a suboptimal scaling-law slope. We conjecture that achieving a more favorable scaling-law slope requires jointly scaling both axes. To support this, we present HELIX, a purified and unified architecture for large-scale recommendation. HELIX interleaves sequence retrieval and feature interaction while enforcing one-way information flow from reusable sequence states to candidate-conditioned mix-tokens. This design preserves cross-depth communication between the two modeling axes while keeping user-side sequence computation amortizable, enabling flexible and asymmetric scaling of sequence modeling and feature interaction. Deployed in TikTok's e-commerce recommendation system, HELIX consistently improves offline CTR AUC, CVR AUC, and other ranking metrics. In online A/B tests, it achieves an approximately 6% increase in e-commerce video GMV per user.
abstract_zh: 工业推荐排序模型通常沿两条轴扩展：对异构用户、物品、上下文及交叉特征进行特征交互，以及对长序列、多类型且信息丰富的用户行为历史进行序列建模。论文发现，单独扩展任一能力都存在性能上限和不理想的 scaling-law 斜率。为获得更优的扩展规律，作者提出 HELIX，一种面向大规模推荐的纯化统一架构。HELIX 交替执行序列检索与特征交互，并约束信息仅从可复用的序列状态流向候选条件化的 mix-tokens，从而在保持两条建模轴跨深度通信的同时，使用户侧序列计算可摊销，并支持序列建模与特征交互的灵活、非对称扩展。HELIX 已部署于 TikTok 电商推荐系统，在线下持续提升 CTR AUC、CVR AUC 等排序指标；在线 A/B 测试中，使电商视频人均 GMV 提升约 6%。
key_points_zh: 论文指出，单独扩大特征交互或序列建模能力均存在 scaling ceiling，且 scaling-law 斜率不理想；联合扩展两者可能带来更优收益。
HELIX 将 sequence retrieval 与 feature interaction 交替堆叠，通过 reusable sequence states 向 candidate-conditioned mix-tokens 的单向信息流实现架构统一。
该设计保留序列建模与特征交互之间的跨深度通信，同时支持用户侧序列计算摊销，降低重复计算成本。
HELIX 支持序列建模和特征交互的灵活、非对称扩展，适合大规模工业推荐系统的计算与容量配置。
在 TikTok 电商推荐系统中，HELIX 提升离线 CTR AUC、CVR AUC 等指标，并在在线 A/B 测试中带来约 6% 的电商视频人均 GMV 增长。

llm_assessment.comment: A strong industrial e-commerce recommendation paper that unifies sequence modeling and feature interaction with substantial online GMV gains.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 该工作面向工业电商推荐统一建模用户行为序列与特征交互，并取得显著的线上GMV提升。
